TC-22/S11.title: Re-save and re-tap: nothing duplicated or reopened; the conditional diet task
TC-22/S11.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Unit T22-S11. A: the pre-round Save Note naming the three typed tasks makes no copies (pass). B: Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text, then a second tap on the unchanged text: 'follow up BMP' and 'PT eval' closed once, weight open, the second tap changes nothing.
